summary: Electronic Arts filed an 8-K updating the status of its acquisition by a consortium (PIF, Silver Lake, Affinity) via a merger. The Merger Agreement was signed September 28, 2025; as of July 30, 2026, all regulatory approvals are obtained. The deal is expected to close on or about August 4, 2026, with stockholders receiving cash per the original terms. Closing remains subject to customary conditions. The company will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent, effectively going private. Watch for final closing announcement and any last-minute condition waivers; risk-arb spreads should narrow toward closing.
